## About
KoJack's Poker Club is a private poker club on West Cuthbert in Midland, set up to be a fun, safe and secure place to play cards in the Permian Basin. Our dealers are skilled professionals, and our staff is here to keep you comfortable.
We spread No Limit Holdem, PLO, Big O and Omaha Hi/Lo, with other variations on request. Daily and monthly memberships include all the amenities and non-alcoholic beverages. We're a BYOB club, and we'll mix your drink of choice.
Players have given us a 4.6 rating from 81 Google reviews. Stop by and see the room for yourself, and follow KoJack's Poker Club on Facebook to keep up with what's going on.

## Services
- Rake free poker games: Rake free games including No Limit Holdem, PLO, Big O and Omaha Hi/Lo. Other poker variations are available on request.
- Tournaments: Competitive tournaments held at the club alongside our cash games.
- Private party and fundraiser tournaments: Texas Hold Em tournaments for benefits, fundraisers, non-profits and corporate parties, at your place or ours. Call us for details.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer memberships?
A: Yes. We offer daily and monthly memberships, and both include all the amenities and non-alcoholic beverages.

Q: Can I bring my own drinks?
A: Yes, KoJack's is BYOB, and our staff can mix your beverage of choice.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open every day starting at 2:00 PM and stay open until close.

## What customers say
- "I’ve been coming here for over a month now, and I look forward to each weekend to spending a couple hours here. The staff is very friendly, and understanding as well. I’m not an avid poker player but it is something I enjoy within moderation. I often don’t pay attention to when I’m the small or big blind and they remind me very politely, which I know can be annoying if you’re trying to run a fast game. They have been very patient with me adjusting to the game play and I have never sensed any tension whilst I have been their. They are friendly games while serving food from a snack bar/grill, or doing fast food runs. To play will cost you 12 dollar daily + 16 an hour for a seat. If you don’t use all your time, don’t worry it will roll over. I’ve never had any suspicion of cheating or inside players (people that actually work there using the poker rooms money and aren’t real players) which is a real thing that has happened in other cities while playing in their poker rooms. The site is very official and friendly and clean and enjoyable to go to even if you lost your buy in. I’ve done well since I’ve started playing here, much better than I do at table games in casinos so that also counts for something. I didn’t know anyone there and showed up on a whim and I’m glad Google maps has lead me here" (John Smith, 5/5)
- "Been to a lot of poker rooms over the years, and KoJack’s has one of the best atmospheres in West Texas. The staff is welcoming, the dealers stay on point, and the games are always solid. Whether you’re there to grind for hours or just relax and play cards with good people, it feels comfortable the minute you walk in. Clean room, well organized tournaments, and a great mix of players. Definitely worth checking out if you enjoy poker in Midland." (Cory Garrison, 5/5)
- "This place is excellent. The house staff are friendly and willing to help. The dealers are knowledgeable, courteous, and personable. They have a variety of games and it's run clean and precise.
